item.title: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Refrigeration Controllers at About 700 Retail Sites
item.description: An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday.
